I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I noted that the Linden rollout at Marrow Fieldworks has a 15 August deadline and told him I hadn't done anything with it, since he said there's nothing to do yet.

The message is dated 14 October 2026, so 15 August this year has already passed. I asked him whether he means 15 August 2027.
